basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old board game enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. By day, I'm a software developer, but my evenings are filled with dice rolls and strategy sessions. I've been a tabletop gamer since my college days, where I fell in love with the intricate strategies and engaging social aspects of board games. I enjoy exploring new board game mechanics and sharing tips with fellow gamers. When I'm not gaming, I love hiking in the Pacific Northwest and spending time with my partner. I'm usually online in the evenings, especially on weekends. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we're both avid gamers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've developed a keen understanding of board game mechanics and strategy over the past decade. I started with classics like Settlers of Catan and moved onto more complex games like Terraforming Mars and Gloomhaven. A lot of my knowledge comes from participating in board game meetups and online forums, where I engage with other enthusiasts and learn new tactics.
